note: Set B captures both page notes (USE-2 10 G.A. current-carrying cable and U.V.-rated cable ties), the ENMA 3R junction box location, the Sunpreme GX290 module and the array output to planer equipment, and its series-connection polarities (SA3-2→SA3-3, SA3-14→SA3-15, SA3-18→SA2-19) match the terminal signs on the sheet. Set A invents a 'wiring material CU' claim with a fabricated quote ('1. ALL CU'), binds two string-to-string connections as positive-to-positive where the drawn terminals are negative-to-positive, and misbinds the 'TO PLANTER EQUIPMENT (SEE E-206)' output to SA2-19 and to the junction box. Set A also repeats the cable spec and the SA2-27 '3' value under different attribute names and treats the '11' bonding-jumper symbol as a connection target. Set B's weaknesses are a garbled module quote, a misread gauge unit ('10 A.G.'), a mislabeled 'identifier 3', and several one-sided terminal claims.
remarks: Text layer is heavily jumbled (labels and polarity marks are in separate blocks), so the mapping of the 27 '+ -' / '- +' terminal pairs to individual SA strings relies on reading order; the four '- +' pairs correspond to SA3-1..SA3-4. The '3' beside each string is most plausibly the module count per string, but the sheet never labels it, so 'quantity'/'value' claims are only weakly supported. Neither set states the legend item '#10G BONDING JUMPER' as a real spec (both reduce it to the bare symbol '11'), and neither captures the 'FRAMLESS GLASS DESIGN (SEE E-502)' cross-reference cleanly.
